Explain the example for index a known sample

blocks.text: Indexing stores a document so search can use its fields. A refresh makes recently indexed data visible to search.

Use a local Elasticsearch 8+ instance with Kibana Dev Tools. Paste the HTTP request examples into that console. Use only the cma-books practice index. This website does not connect to an Elasticsearch server.
Read the code step by step

items: PUT writes the given document id in the explicitly mapped index.
refresh=wait_for waits for normal search visibility before returning to this learning workflow.

blocks.text: The response waits until the new sample can be found by search.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Forcing frequent immediate refreshes can hurt throughput. Use refresh=wait_for only when the workflow needs visibility before continuing.
